string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: A long piece of information, like the title of the last video, now ends in “…” and no longer pushes the others out; “Opened 0 minutes ago” became “Opened now”
Home: with Home Assistant offline, the screen says what happened and that it retries by itself, and Google Home stays at hand
After the screensaver, focus returns to the home screen, not to the top bar
Lighter navigation: the selected icon only starts its animation after the column stops moving
Settings › System › “How this TV is doing”: 7 measurements of the TV, with number and target
Live TV: hold ▲▼ to browse channel names without switching the video; release to switch once
Series: “Skip intro” button; the chosen subtitle is saved for each series
Search that forgives typos (“netflx” finds Netflix) and search inside settings
High contrast, audio description and subtitles for the deaf in Settings
Changed settings show “Undo” for 10 s; Settings › System › “Recent changes”
On the network: a movie folder becomes a catalog with clean titles and “S1 E2”
Panel: one-day invite for guests, backup recovery key and “Move to a new TV”
Stability fixes from a long debugging round

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: Opening a movie’s details, does its scene show on the right without getting in the way of reading?
Holding BACK inside an app (YouTube, for example) and on the home screen, does the quick panel open, and does a short BACK still go back?
Holding HOME, inside an app and on the home screen, does Home open with your lights and scenes?
Do the icons have different colors, and does the selected one play a short animation of its own every few seconds?
Opening YouTube from its column and pressing HOME, does the focus go back to YouTube (and not to TV)?
